y3p9tc:295: An in-depth technical article co-authored by Martin Fowler and Kent Beck, using Bayer Pharmaceuticals' PRINCE (Preclinical Information Center) system as a case study, systematically elaborating the architectural methodology for building reliable Agentic AI systems. The article details the three-stage evolution from Search → Ask → Do, the multi-Agent orchestration architecture based on LangGraph, a three-layer reflection mechanism (process reflection, data reflection, draft reflection), as well as production-grade error handling and evaluation systems. This is one of the most complete public case studies of Harness Engineering and Context Engineering in enterprise-grade AI systems.
